maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly consulting, technology and engineering services on government programs, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are U.S. federal government: defense, intelligence and civil agencies; also built Recreation.gov for public lands.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through government contract wins and organic work; acquisitions of small tech firms are only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Embedded in national security, defense and cyber programs; clearances and incumbent systems make switching costly and risky.
